description:
Migrate the TRSM blocked threshold and panel width (the design's split of one source constant) to runtime resolved reads.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.5, D3, and the triangular row of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: trsm_blocked_min_dim and trsm_panel_rows are runtime resolved reads at both guards, satisfying design §2.3, both defaulting to the one source constant.
- [hard] REQ-02: trsm_route reporter called by the dispatcher, boundary route files, and a witness that the panel width reaches the blocked callees pass.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rustdoc names the profile fields; existing tests pass unchanged.
title: Cut the triangular-solve selectors over to the tuning profile
